Multi-developer task claims: claim, release, status

Git-tracked claim files under .wombo-combo/claims/ tell teammates who works on which task. Claims expire after team.claimTtlHours (default 24). With team.enabled the daemon skips tasks claimed by another developer and claims/releases tasks as agents start and finish.

```sh
woco team <subcommand> [flags]
```

Modifies project state.

## Global flags

| Flag | Alias | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--output` | `-o` | string | `"text"` | Output format: text (default), json, or toon. Values: `text`, `json`, `toon`. |
| `--force` |  | boolean | `false` | Force overwrite / skip safety prompts |

## team merge-meta
